nuance.intro: A free web tool that teaches you to read the label of a plant-based meat alternative in 30 seconds. Designed and built for a dietetics student's final-year project at HEPH-Condorcet.
nuance.context: Plant-based alternatives are everywhere on the shelves, but their labels are hard to decode. The student wanted a simple tool to help beginners form their own opinion — no ready-made score, no judgement.
nuance.challenge: Turn rigorous dietetics content into something anyone understands in seconds, on a phone, in the shop.
approach: Understand the project and its nutrition markers with the student
Design a three-step journey: scan, read, decide
Create a soft, reassuring identity: cream, brown, sage
Build it in React with Open Food Facts data
nuance.result: A free tool, online, no account needed, supporting her final-year project. A very happy client.

hybrid.intro: An all-in-one CrossFit platform: an international competition calendar, live tracking, organiser tools and a mobile app. Built during my internship.
hybrid.context: CrossFit competitions are often run with scattered tools: registrations here, results there, updates on social media. Hybrid Timing brings everything together.
hybrid.challenge: Design a rich platform (organising, judging, check-in, live results) that stays clear for athletes and organisers alike, on desktop and on mobile.
approach: Map the needs of athletes, judges and organisers
Build a strong identity: black, yellow, sporty type
Build the web interface in React
Build the mobile app in Dart / Flutter
hybrid.result: A complete platform, launching soon. A very happy team.
